blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — A sub-committee of ranking lawmakers tasked with reviewing proposed tweaks to the 2027 spending bill has held preparatory meetings to set the agenda and finalize the subject that will be discussed when it formally convenes, though it did not take up substantial amendments yet. Deputy Speaker Ronaldo Puno said the Budget Amendments Review Sub-committee (BARSc) already held preliminary sessions to set the panel’s formal schedule and the flow of proceedings once lawmakers from major political parties and the minority bloc meet to discuss changes to the P7.2-trillion spending bill. “The pre-BARSc is akin to an organizational meeting [where] […]...
